thread:
emma: Heads-up — we need a concise dataset & sanity runs for the launch press bench. Goal: include warmup effects + variance breakdown so marketing can show realistic cold vs warmed curves. Can eng/runtime run the checklist by EOD? Need sample artifacts (raw logs + 20 example outputs) and p50/p95/p99 latency + token-cost breakdown. Deadline = 48h.

kai: Yep, we can do that. Two quick clarifying Qs: which model variants should we include (fp16 baseline, quantized variants)? And do you want separate coldstart runs (no warmup) and warmed runs, or just a warmup curve? Also how many seeds/replicates for variance?

emma: Include fp16 baseline and the q4f16 quantized variant. We want: 1) coldstart (no worker warmup) 2) warmup sweep (200, 500, 1000 req warmup buckets) 3) variance runs: 5 seeds per bucket. For marketing artifacts we also need 20 example outputs per workload (diverse prompts).

ben: Sounds good. Proposed run matrix: 
- model: redwood-1-small (fp16) + redwood-1-small-q4f16
- workloads: long-form summarization (2k tokens), chat multi-turn (avg 6 turns), single-turn short completion (<=64 tokens)
- warmup buckets: 0, 200, 500, 1000
- seeds: 5
Metrics to collect: per-request latency (tokens and wall), token throughput, cost-per-token estimate, KV cache hit rate, and p50/p95/p99. Save raw per-token timelines.

ben: quick run command for the bench-runner (example):
```
./bench-runner \
  --model redwood-1-small \
  --variant q4f16 \
  --workload longform \
  --warmup 500 \
  --seeds 5 \
  --out s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/bench-12345/
```

sara: For the sample outputs, please include the input prompt + model output + generation log (sampling params). Also ask runtime to include a small qualitative check: 20 outputs flagged where output length > expected or off-topic. We can hand-validate those. Metrics we need in CSV + JSONL with per-request tokens.

emma: Prompt packs are on the marketing drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/launch/prompts — use the three folders matching workloads. Tag artifacts with "launch2026-marketing" and include a README in the artifact bundle describing the run matrix and seeds.

kai: Got it. I'll schedule two parallel job sets (fp16 baseline, q4f16 quantized). Warmup sweep as specified, 5 seeds. Output path = s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/bench-2481122334/ . Will include CSV + JSONL + sample_outputs/ with 20 examples per workload. ETA ~12 hours from now. Any objections to 3 shards per job to reduce wall time?

emma: 3 shards is fine. Please also attach a short heatmap image (latency vs warmup) and a short README blurb marketing can copy.

ben: Scheduling now. Run ID = bench-2481122334-01 (fp16 baseline), bench-2481122334-02 (q4f16). Expect finish ~2481128000 (will update). I'll toss logs to the s3 path and create a tiny presigned link list in the README.

deploy-bot: [automated] Job queued: bench-2481122334-01. Queue position: 2.

kai: One more note — we'll capture coldstart traces from a fresh instance (no cache) and a warmed trace after 1k warmup. Also capturing KV cache size metrics.

emma: Fantastic, appreciate it. If you can ping here when artifacts land, marketing will start drafting the benchmark narrative and visuals. :rocket:
